description: Defines a 'Progress' class representing per-lesson progress for a user, including properties such as userId, lessonId, completion status, current step, score, and last updated timestamp. Includes a copyWith method for creating modified copies.

classes.name: Progress
classes.description: Represents user's progress in a lesson, tracking completion status, current step, score, and update time.

methods.name: Progress.copyWith
methods.description: Creates a new instance of Progress with specified fields modified, enabling immutable updates.
